sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Primary Education and Local Councils High Schools Sindh Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXII OF 1972
ACT XXII OF 1972
WEST PAKISTAN PRIMARY EDUCATION AND LOCAL
COUNCILS HIGH SCHOOLS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1972
An
Act to amend the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962 and the West
Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970 in their
application to the Province of Sind.
[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th
December 1972]
(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the
Gazette of Sind (Extraordinary), dated the 28th December 1972).-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the West Pakistan Primary Education and Local Councils
High Schools (Sind Amendment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall be
deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of October 1972.

2. Amendment of section 2 of West Pakistan
Ordinance XXIX of 1962.--In the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance,
1962 (West Pakistan Ordinance XXIX of 1962), in section 2, in clause (g), the
words "and includes a municipality or Municipal Corporation" shall be
added before the semi-colon at the end.

ACT XXII OF 1972

An
Act to amend the West Pakistan Primary Education Ordinance, 1962 and the West

[Gazette of Sind, Extraordinary, 28th

(First
published after having received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the

4. Power to issue notifications
retrospectively.--Any notification applying the West Pakistan Primary
Education Ordinance, 1962 (West Pakistan Ordinance XXIX of 1962) or the West
Pakistan Local Councils High Schools (Taking Over) Ordinance, 1970 (West
Pakistan Ordinance XV of 1970) to any municipality or Municipal Corporation,
may take effect from any date not prior to the 1st day of October 1972.
